full_judgment: 5. Further plaint case is that amongst the sons of Banku Bihar', Baidya Nath was the eldest and used to look after the entire property. During survey, he got the entire land recorded both in SA and RS Khatian in his name only. The plaintiffs along with defendant no. 1 Birendranath and defendant no.2 Kalipad Mondal all through were in joint possession. The suit land was never partitioned by metes and bounds. When in the month of July, 2000 demand for partition was refused for the last time, the plaintiff was constrained to institute the suit.
